subject: Tracing & retention: bundle pricing proposal for Arcadia Health
messages:
From: Janelle Brooks <janelle@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tracing & retention pricing for trial — Arcadia Health

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week. We're excited about Redwood's tracing and retention features plus the advanced dashboards — two quick asks before we can move this over to procurement: 1) can you send a baseline pricing estimate for tracing (we currently expect ~12M traces/mo, 30-day retention for full traces + 6 months for sampled summaries) and 2) how do dashboard editor seats factor into the add-on?

Also, we have a procurement window in the first week of July. If there's room for a multi-quarter discount or an onboarding credit for a pilot, that would help our internal approval.

Thanks —
Janelle Brooks
Head of Platform 
Arcadia Health

""

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Janelle Brooks <janelle@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tracing & retention pricing for trial — Arcadia Health

Hi Janelle — appreciated the walkthrough last week. Long answer made short: we can support the footprint you described with two common pricing constructs and a recommended pilot pack.

Options (high level):
- Pay-as-you-go (metered): per-million-trace units + per-GB retention. Best for uncertain volume; no commit.
- Slab/committed: tiered price breaks for committed traces/month + retention included up to a slab cap. Cheaper per-unit at higher commit.

Dashboards: editor seats are licensed per-seat; we bundle 5 editor seats with the advanced dashboards add-on at a reduced seat rate, additional editors billed monthly.

Suggested pilot pack for Arcadia (what I think maps to your ask):
- 12M traces/month baseline, 30 days full retention + 6 months sampled summaries (we can sample summaries at customer-defined rates).
- Bundle includes advanced dashboards with 6 editor seats.
- Offer an onboarding credit to offset ingestion/transformation work and a time-limited discount on the first 6 months for committed pilots.

To give exact numbers I need two quick clarifications: estimated monthly retention volume (GB) for the full traces, and whether you expect retention to be warm (hot storage) for quick query vs cold archive. I"'ll loop in Pricing (Kimberly) and Product (Soojin) to align on the concession path if you want a multi-quarter commitment.

Next steps: if you can share the rough GB/month for the 30-day retention and confirm whether 6 editors is accurate, I will send a formal two-option quote (paygo vs 12-month slab) and a mutual action plan.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

""

From: Janelle Brooks <janelle@arcadiahealth.com>

Thanks Marcus — quick numbers from infra:
- Estimated full-trace retention: ~620 GB/month for 30 days (mostly spans and trace payload).
- Sampled summaries (~6 months): ~120 GB/month.
- Dashboard editors: yes, 6 editors to start; expect another 4-6 editors within 3 quarters.

Procurement note: we're aiming to sign by the end of June / PO in early July. That said, our finance team is pushing for a 20-25% discount in year one given the multi-quarter pilot and startup risk. If Redwood can accommodate that range plus a modest onboarding credit, we can accelerate the internal approval.

Appreciate the clarity —
Janelle

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-17T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tracing & retention pricing for trial — Arcadia Health

Hi Janelle — appreciate the quick numbers; that helps. Attached is a focused commercial proposal (redwood-pricing-grid-v3.pdf) and a mutual action plan (Arcadia-MAP-2026.xlsx). TL;DR of the proposal below.

Final pilot offer (customized):
- Commitment: 12-month pilot, committed monthly baseline 12M traces
- Tracing pricing: slab model at $14.00 per million traces for the committed slab; overage billed at $18.50 per million. (Samples/summaries billed at a lower summary tier.)
- Retention: 30-day full-trace retention included up to 700 GB/month in the slab; sampled 6-month summaries included up to 150 GB/month. Warm storage for the 30-day retention (fast query) included in slab.
- Dashboards: 6 editor seats included in the advanced dashboards add-on. Additional editors: $225/editor/month.
- Commercial concessions: 20% off list prices for months 1–12 on both tracing and retention; a one-time onboarding credit of $15,000 to offset ingestion and mapping work, applied as a billing credit over the first 3 invoices.
- Conditions: requires a 12-month commitment and a signed SOW before kickoff; standard Redwood licensing and data-processing terms apply.

Why this structure: it gives Arcadia predictable unit economics and a clear overage path if you spike. The onboarding credit accelerates your implementation and covers the initial ETL/time investment. We can re-open pricing at renewal to reflect actual usage and any seat expansion.

If this is acceptable, next steps we propose in the MAP:
1) Procurement gets procurement@arcadiahealth.com to send a formal PO referencing deal RD-2391 by 2026-06-30.
2) Redwood legal sends the SOW and standard addendum (we'll try to keep it to a single-sheet SOW for the pilot) by 2026-06-18.
3) Kickoff and ingest window: target week of 2026-07-06.

If you need more discount, Kimberly has suggested tradeoffs (longer commit, larger commit slab, or reduced included editor seats). Kimberly — looping you for confirmation if 20% + $15k credit is within acceptable concession ranges for a deal of this size and region. Soojin — can you confirm the retention/aggregation approach for the 6-month summaries (sampling rate assumptions) so we can lock the included summary GB?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call to walk procurement through the MAP.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-pricing-grid-v3.pdf (pricing grid), Arcadia-MAP-2026.xlsx (mutual action plan)
